activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom, fan running for air circulation
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
Boiling the kettle, making toast and preparing a relaxed holiday breakfast, then eating it
Tidying the living room, vacuuming the floor and watering plants on a day off
Walking to the local shops for groceries and household supplies
Putting away groceries and cooking a simple lunch on the induction cooker
Eating lunch and cleaning up the dishes afterwards
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
Working on personal computer at the desk lamp, reviewing community program notes and answering emails
Taking a walk in the park and catching up with community contacts by phone
Cooking dinner using the oven and induction cooker, then eating it
Watching TV and playing a game on the game console
Taking a warm shower with the water heater and getting ready for bed
Winding down, reading on the phone and dimming the desk lamp
